where: my own one-off migration script in this lane (doc strings moved next to their functions)
what: The script put `import type { Docs }` before the first `import ` it found in each file by text; in packages.ts and three others the first match was inside the header comment, so the import landed in the middle of a comment.
cost: ten minutes, caught by reading the output
cause: an edit by text where the tree has no by-name tool for TypeScript
class: text edits that match inside comments or strings
prevention: none built: rule fix-through-blaze-lints covers Rust only. For TypeScript here, anchor on `^import ` and read the diff.
fix: a by-syntax edit tool for the TypeScript in crates/harness if such moves recur
